title: FINOM: Fast Sinkhorn on Non-uniform Meshes
summary: A linear-complexity algorithm for computing the Wasserstein-1 distance on non-uniform meshes is proposed. This work extends the fast Sinkhorn algorithms from [Q. Liao et al., Commun. Math. Sci., 20(2022)] and [Q. Liao et al., J. Sci. Comput., 98 (2024)] to non-uniform meshes. In those prior works, a distinctive collinear structure of the kernel matrix on uniform meshes was identified, enabling \(O(N)\) acceleration via dynamic programming.
